payload.reason: The evidence indicates that RR-based fingerprint construction is crucial for achieving a high signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) in detecting forced responses in precipitation data.

claims.text: RR-based fingerprint construction significantly enhances the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) for detecting forced responses in precipitation data.
Without RR-based fingerprint construction, the detection of forced trends in precipitation may be compromised due to the influence of internal variability and structural model error.
